message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The failure came from a column name mismatch. The `001_create_users.js` migration creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` was reading and writing `full_name`. I changed `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname`.

I left the migration alone. It is already applied in production and the DBA team owns it, so changing the code was the safer fix.
